en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a European city with a river running through the center, lined with trees and multi‑story buildings on both banks. Several bridges cross the river. On the left shore a building shows the sign "HOTEL FLORIAN". On the right side, a hill rises with a fortification or castle-like complex and a tower on top, overlooking the city. Mountains are visible in the distant background. The top left corner has the printed word "Graz".
